Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: User-submitted product suggestion, improvement idea, or bug report delivered to the Dayline app owner inbox.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the suggestion.

authorName.description: Display name of the user submitting the suggestion.

authorEmail.description: Verified Google account email of the sender (visible only to the sender and the verified app owner).

category.description: Type of suggestion submitted by the user.

title.description: Concise summary of what to add or change.

message.description: Detailed explanation of the user's suggestion or feedback.

status.description: Triage workflow status managed by the app owner.

ownerReply.description: Optional response note from the app owner back to the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the suggestion was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the suggestion was last updated.

/suggestions/{suggestionId}.description: Stores user product suggestions and owner triage replies, readable only by the submitting author or the verified app owner.
